benet-mount-elgon-2008.whole: By the World Bank's own completion report, visitors to Uganda's protected areas rose from 66,542 to an estimated 142,884 (target 200,000), with only "a portion" of the rise credited to the project, and about UgSh 110 million of park gate money went to Mount Elgon communities in 2002-2010; it says boundary changes let communities at Mount Elgon stay, and does not mention the 2008 evictions. A review by the Global Environment Facility's evaluation office rated the project's outcomes moderately satisfactory and found "no evidence that an independent evaluation was performed". The carbon project had planted more than 8,000 of a planned 25,000 hectares by 2006, by the wildlife authority's count, and villagers in two areas said it gave them no jobs (World Rainforest Movement).
benet-mount-elgon-2008.searched: World Bank completion report, GEF evaluation office review, WRM study of the FACE project. No independent measure of benefits at Mount Elgon found.

caracol-industrial-park-haiti.whole: The park's main tenant, Sae-A, promised 20,000 jobs over four years, and Al Jazeera America reported a US State Department promise of 65,000. Al Jazeera America counted fewer than 1,500 jobs in 2013; Sae-A reached about 12,000 workers before COVID-19 and in 2023 was cutting from about 7,000 to 3,500, in a letter announcing layoffs; the IDB had disbursed about $243 million by 2019. Union leaders told Le Nouvelliste in December 2024 that factory closures had caused a further sharp fall in jobs.

In a 2018 ADB video on 174 km of road works, a freight company owner says heavy traffic rose 2-3 times and his drivers' trip from Torugart to Bishkek fell from about 15 to 10 hours; this is the lender's own video, and no independent count was found. peru-sterilization-campaigns.whole: USAID's own closeout report on its Peru health and family planning work says maternal deaths fell from 265 to 185 per 100,000 live births between 1996 and 2000, and claims a 35% fall in its focus areas against 5% elsewhere; the report does not mention sterilization, and no independent check of that comparison was found. An independent study (Battaglia and Pallarés, 2020) of the government's 1996-2000 family planning programme found about 10 percentage points more contraceptive use and neonatal and infant deaths down 5-6 points in treated areas, while warning it cannot claim cause and effect. Another study (Rendon, 2020) estimates that 211,000 of about 331,000 women sterilized by the government in 1993-2000 did not get complete information.

karachi-brt-red-line-university-road.whole: The line is meant to serve commuters: the ADB projected more than 300,000 passengers a day and up to 1.5 million people living within a kilometre of a station. It is unfinished, so these are projections and no transport benefit has been measured.

wwf-cameroon-baka-ecoguards.whole: The ecoguard funding was to protect wildlife from poaching. A survey by WWF and Cameroon's forestry ministry, reported in 2025, estimated 1,004 forest elephants and 19,472 great apes in and around Boumba Bek and Nki, with numbers relatively stable since 2016, after a 2015-16 survey found elephants there down by more than 75%. These are WWF's own counts, no independent check was found, and they do not show what the ecoguard money itself did.

african-parks-odzala-baka.whole: A 2012 census by the Wildlife Conservation Society, done for African Parks, found about 9,600 forest elephants with no significant change since 2005, while gorillas fell from nearly 40,000 in 2005 to 22,000 in 2012, which the release puts down to hunting and Ebola; African Parks took over in 2010. African Parks now says elephants and gorillas are "growing", without counts on its page, and that 97% of permanent staff are Congolese, over 65% from communities near the park. No independent check of those later claims was found, and IUCN's ape database lists the park's ape numbers and trends as unknown.

It says no adverse effects on local residents had been reported, and it does not name Karenni State or its people. No independent check was found.

chitwan-wwf-ranger-custody-death.whole: Rhinos in Chitwan rose from about 370 when Nepal's war ended in 2006 to 605 as reported in 2017, and Nepal recorded years free of rhino poaching in 2013, 2015 and 2016 (Mongabay, which does not say who counted); WWF's share of this is not measured. Buffer-zone communities receive 30-50% of park revenue, yet a 2015 study of 68 households in one village found 73% of those nearest the park could not grow enough food for about six months to a year, against 47% further away.

A SourceMaterial, Guardian and Die Zeit investigation said the claim to have prevented some deforestation holds up, but that the project received about 10 times the credits it deserved, which Conservation International disputes. REDD-Monitor reports that half of enrolled families saw income fall and 39% did not renew.

The team, the Tanzanian NGO coalition FEMACT, reported that villages were handed cheques of TZS 25,000 in August 2009, some elders forced to accept them, and that its visit to all the villages showed they were not aware of receiving the money.

plan-colombia-aerial-spraying.whole: The goal was to halve drug production in six years; the US Government Accountability Office found opium poppy and heroin down about 50% but coca cultivation up about 15% and cocaine output up about 4% in 2000-2006, while security improved. Economist Daniel Mejía found 32 hectares had to be sprayed to remove one hectare of coca, at about $240,000 per kilo of cocaine kept off the retail market. Coca later fell from about 160,000 hectares in 2000 to about 48,000 in 2013, which he suggests owes more to seizures and lab raids than to spraying.

libya-coast-guard-eu-italy-detention.whole: By the EU's own count, its trust fund had given 46,540 migrants in Libya help to return home by June 2022; no independent count was found. EU auditors, refused access to the EU-funded detention centres, reported in 2024 from monitoring reports that conditions improved slightly where works were done but "the treatment of detainees did not change", that Libya's EU-equipped rescue centre was "not yet operational", and that there was "insufficient data" to link the money to Libyan border capacity. Across the fund, they found over-reporting of outputs in 13 of 16 projects sampled.

The EU publishes its own counts of people reached, but no clear figure for Morocco, Tunisia or Mauritania alone was found.
